definitionZh: 中风线连接 CSS 属性定义了 SVG 元素中风路径的角落所使用的形状. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The stroke-linejoin CSS property defines the shape to be used at the corners of an SVG element's stroked paths. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The stroke-linejoin CSS property defines the shape to be used at the corners of an SVG element's stroked paths. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
